observations: Two car headlight assemblies wrapped in clear plastic film.
The headlights have a modern, angular design with a clear lens and a visible projector lens.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlights themselves.
The plastic wrapping is intact, suggesting they are new or unused.
The background shows a workshop or storage area with concrete and metal structures.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or part numbers to confirm originality; the plastic wrapping may be new, but not proof of origin.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlights may not be original Toyota parts, or may be counterfeit or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the part number or VIN tag on the back of the headlight, or a photo showing the headlight installed on a Toyota vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or non-original parts, which are typically cheaper than genuine Toyota parts.

risks.risk: The headlights may be damaged or defective, such as cracked lenses or broken internal components.
risks.proof: A photo showing the internal structure of the headlight, including the bulb socket and wiring, without the plastic wrap.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The headlights may not fit the buyer's vehicle model or year.
risks.proof: A photo showing the part number or a matching part number on the back of the headlight, or a photo of the headlight installed on a vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible, which reduces value significantly.

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the back of the headlight showing any part numbers or markings.
A photo of the headlight installed on a vehicle to confirm fitment.
A photo of the internal components without the plastic wrap to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
